provenance: AI-prepared summaries of the linked primary project descriptions and paper abstracts, checked 2026-10-15; not full-paper extraction

records.title: Modular large language model agents for multi-task computational materials science
records.summary: The framework connects language-model task routing with materials retrieval, continuum simulations, crystal generation and molecular dynamics. It demonstrates task-specific scientific tool integration.
records.scope: A research framework, not evidence that a newly generated structure has been synthesized.

records.title: Autonomous in-silico inorganic materials discovery via multi-agent physics-aware scientific reasoning
records.summary: Scientific agents organize ideas, workflows, computational exploration and result review for inorganic materials design. The report includes limitations and further validation steps.
records.scope: Computational candidates require appropriate calculation and experimental validation.

records.title: BayBE: a Bayesian Back End for experimental planning in the low-to-no-data regime
records.summary: Bayesian optimization supports experimental planning with numerical and categorical parameters, feasibility constraints and multiple targets. A campaign alternates recommendations and new measurements.
records.scope: Recommendations are model-based decisions rather than measured improvements.

records.title: pymatgen materials analysis
records.summary: Structure and composition objects, electronic-structure data, phase-diagram analysis and file interfaces support materials analysis and simulation workflows.
records.scope: Computed data and supplied structures determine what can be concluded.

records.title: impedance.py electrochemical impedance analysis
records.summary: Equivalent-circuit models fit complex impedance spectra and predict frequency-dependent responses. Fitted parameters and residuals support quantitative electrochemical data analysis.
records.scope: A good fit alone does not establish a unique physical mechanism.

records.title: Docling document processing
records.summary: Document conversion preserves structured text, tables and reading order for downstream retrieval and scientific evidence extraction workflows.
records.scope: Document conversion and citation-linked retrieval still require source checking.
